title: AnnounceProcessor rejects hop_count>MAX instead of install-without-relay
description: test/vectors/announce_relay.json vector no_forward_beyond_max_hops expects hop_count 16 > MAX_ANNOUNCE_HOPS=15 to yield action=accept, update_gradient=true, forward=false with reason max_hops_exceeded, matching the spec/05-routing.md section 9.3 pseudocode (install gradient unconditionally after signature/staleness checks; relay only if hop_count < MAX). Python AnnounceProcessor.process() instead rejects outright with AnnounceRejectReason.HOP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and leaves the gradient table untouched. Divergent semantics; needs a decision on which behavior is canonical before the vector can be consumed. Current behavior pinned by test_announce_beyond_max_hops_documented_divergence in python/tests/test_ipv6_routing_relay_vectors.py.
